definition_en: a place where children go to learn, or to train someone, or a group of fish swimming together
core_image: 教室黑板前孩子们举手回答问题，窗外操场一片安静

senses.title: A place where children go to learn
senses.definition: A place where children go to learn
senses.example: Our school has a new library.
senses.exampleCN: 我们学校有了一座新图书馆。

senses.why: Because a school trains minds, the noun turned into a verb meaning to train or discipline.
senses.whyCN: 因为学校训练头脑，名词转为动词，指训练或磨炼。

senses.title: A group of fish swimming together
senses.definition: A group of fish swimming together
senses.example: A school of fish moved past the reef.

core_image: 窗外树叶由绿转黄，厨房里主人正给汤撒盐
scene: 窗外树叶由绿转黄，厨房里主人正给汤撒盐。Autumn is my favourite season.
sceneCN: 这里 season 是「季节」（第 01 个义项）；句意是秋天是我最喜欢的季节。

senses.title: One of the four parts of the year
senses.definition: One of the four parts of the year
senses.definitionCN: 一年中按气候划分的一段
senses.example: Autumn is my favourite season.
senses.exampleCN: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节。
senses.why: Season came from Latin satio, a sowing; the word first marked the time for planting, then any part of the year with its own weather.
senses.whyCN: season 源自拉丁语 satio（播种），最初指播种的时令，后指气候各异的四季。

senses.title: A fixed period for a sport or activity
senses.definition: A fixed period for a sport or activity
senses.definitionCN: 体育或活动固定的时段
senses.example: The football season starts in August.
senses.why: Because each activity has its own proper time, season came to mean the period set aside for it.
senses.whyCN: 因为每项活动都有合宜的时令，season 引申为为其划定的时段。

senses.title: To add salt or spices to food
senses.definition: To add salt or spices to food
senses.example: Season the soup with a little salt.
senses.why: The verb came from the noun: to season food is to give it the flavour proper to its time, salting and spicing it.
senses.whyCN: 动词由名词而来：给食物调味，就是按合宜的时机加盐加香料。

senses.title: The dark shape cast by an object

senses.example: A shadow of doubt crossed her face.
senses.exampleCN: 她脸上掠过一丝疑虑的阴影。

senses.whyCN: 因为影子会让所落之处变暗，这个词也指心头的阴郁。

definition_en: to rest with eyes closed, a period of such rest, or to provide beds for people
core_image: 夜里孩子把被子拉到下巴，床头小灯还亮着，呼吸渐渐变慢
scene: 夜里孩子把被子拉到下巴，床头小灯还亮着，呼吸渐渐变慢。The baby sleeps through the night.
sceneCN: 这里 sleep 是「睡觉」（第 01 个义项）；句意是婴儿整夜安睡。

senses.title: To rest with eyes closed
senses.definition: To rest with eyes closed
senses.example: The baby sleeps through the night.
senses.why: Old English slæpan meant to rest in sleep; the old past form slept survived in modern English.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 slæpan 意为睡中休息，旧过去式 slept 沿用至今。

senses.title: A period of sleeping
senses.definition: A period of sleeping
senses.example: He needs eight hours of sleep.
senses.why: The verb became a noun naming the rest itself, as in a good night's sleep.
senses.whyCN: 动词转为名词，指这段休息本身，如一夜好眠。

senses.title: To provide beds for people
senses.definition: To provide beds for people
senses.example: The hotel sleeps forty guests.
senses.exampleCN: 这家旅馆可住四十位客人。
senses.why: A place that sleeps people gives them room to sleep, so the verb gained this sense of lodging.
senses.whyCN: 能让人睡下的地方提供了睡眠的空间，动词便有了提供住宿之意。
